newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Military seize refugee children in Zaire - UNICEF.
newsitem.headline: Military seize refugee children in Zaire - UNICEF.

text.p: Men in military uniforms seized some 50 Rwandan Hutu refugee children from a hospital in eastern Zaire near the border with Rwanda at the weekend and took them away, the United Nations Children's Fund UNICEF said on Monday.

Quoting a telephoned report from a UNICEF official in the region, the agency's Geneva office said the incident took place on Saturday at Lwiro, some 30 km (19 miles) north of Bukavu, in territory held by the Zairean rebel Alliance.

"About 20 men in military uniforms drove up in trucks on Saturday morning and fired in the air to warn people not to leave their homes," spokeswoman Francesca Toso quoted the UNICEF official in Zaire as saying.

"They then stormed into the paediatric hospital, where the children were being treated for serious malnutrition, took them out and put them on trucks, together with some adult refugees, and drove off, warning they might come back."

They gave no indication of where they were taking the refugees, according to UNICEF. Toso said international aid agencies in the area had started an immediate investigation, but there were no more details at this point of what had happened.
The children were being treated under a malnutrition programme being run by the British-based charity Save the Children and financed by UNICEF, the spokeswoman added.
